Limitation

37. Although the Team was able to demonstrate the correlation between the rapid fire spread along the re-entrant and deterioration of conditions in the staircases, corridors, and lift lobbies, the Team encountered difficulties in determining the exact time of deterioration for each of the staircases, corridors, and lift lobbies as not all re-entrants and not all buildings experienced the observed rapid fire spread. Furthermore, we can only deduce from the available information a brief account of the onset of deterioration, rather than making a quantitative assessment of the breach of tenable conditions in the manner mentioned in Footnote 1.

38. Even with the use of CFD simulation, it is infeasible to accurately determine the onset of untenability at each building, as factors, such as the fire point of origin, exact ignition time, initial fire size, and the distribution of combustibles in individual buildings, significantly influenced the development of tenable conditions. These factors cannot be determined with certainty due to the absence of eyewitness accounts or concrete evidence.
